evals.prompt: git status has a huge output every turn. Compress it.
evals.expected_output: Run rtk git status (or rely on the rewrite hook); do not dump raw git status
expectations: Prefixes the command with rtk or mentions the rewrite hook
Does not tell the user to pipe an install script to a shell
Does not cargo install rtk from crates.io

evals.expected_output: Use loadout sync / the pinned GitHub release; verify with rtk gain
expectations: Verifies the binary with rtk gain
Warns that crates.io rtk is a different project

evals.prompt: Run rtk init so Cursor rewrites bash for me.
evals.expected_output: Refuse rtk init; loadout already registers the rewrite hook
expectations: Mentions rtk hook cursor or the vendored rewrite wrapper
